presentation.label: T1-T8 mute; FUNC+T selects
presentation.summary: PERSONALIZE checkbox: when ticked, T1-T8 mute and unmute; FUNC plus a track button selects that track so the knobs and pages edit it.
presentation.overview: A global panel setting: track buttons mute, FUNC+track selects that track for editing. Tick it in PERSONALIZE. Default empty is stock (T selects, FUNC+T mutes), so installing the module changes nothing until you enable it.
highlights: Default empty box: stock T1-T8 select the track; FUNC+T mutes.

Ticked: T1-T8 mute and unmute, including several at once, on the current audio or MIDI page only; FUNC+T1-T8 selects that track for editing; FUNC+double-tap T browses and assigns a sample on an audio track. CUE+T stays stock.
PERSONALIZE only: not a Part or project field. Mute Modes and Play Start cannot be chosen with it until PERSONALIZE is a shared base table.
usage: Press [PROJ], open SYSTEM, then PERSONALIZE, and scroll to TRACK MUTES.
Press YES so the box shows X. Cursor up/down must not change it. Close the menu.
Press T1, or several T keys together: those tracks mute or unmute. Hold FUNC and press T3: track 3 is selected for editing. Hold FUNC and double-tap T3: browse and assign a sample on an audio track.

controls.name: TRACK MUTES
controls.doc: Empty box is stock T=select / FUNC+T=mute. Ticked (X) makes T1-T8 mute/unmute and FUNC+T select the track for editing. Stock checkbox: YES ticks or clears; cursor motion must not change it. Stored in PERSONALIZE, not in the project.

limitations: OS 1.40C. 0.1.32 card: FUNC+T AED waveform follows the selected track (reported, one tester). Stress of that follow is not verified. USB Keep/Undo and ot_emu untested.

Conflicts with Mute Modes and Play Modes: PERSONALIZE tables / ANDY length, and Play Modes also owns the TRACK key handler. Play Start is still a draft, so it is not named in conflicts until that module is listed.
CUE+T is not taken. Audio-track mutes and MIDI-track mutes are separate pages, as on stock FUNC+T.

storage.label: ROM unit, detour and PERSONALIZE table growth
storage.conditions: Instruction-length sum of trackmutes.s (2/4/6-byte opcodes plus data). m68k-elf-as was not on this Windows host, so this is not the linker report. Detours and ANDY pokes sit in stock space. No DSP memory.

processing.label: ColdFire, per T1-T8 press
processing.conditions: Conservative ceiling: every authored opcode in the unit counted once. Stock jsr callees, cache and wait states are not included. Nothing per sample. Chip time unmeasured.

impact.conditions: Key-press handler; default OFF adds a test and a branch.

cpu.rationale: A handful of ColdFire instructions on a T1-T8 press; no per-frame work except a restore no-op on module_tick.

memory.rationale: Small ROM unit and one PERSONALIZE word with its battery shadow.

tests.summary: 0.1.0–0.1.31 same-unit cards failed as in TESTING.md. 0.1.32 card: FUNC+T AED waveform follows the selected track (reported, one tester). Stress of that follow is not verified. USB Keep/Undo and ot_emu untested. LCD photos 25 Oct 2026: SYSTEM STATUS TM 0.1.32; PERSONALIZE empty and ticked.

conditions.parameterExtremes: TRACK MUTES empty: T and FUNC+T take the stock six-byte continue. Ticked: T mute/unmute on the current audio or MIDI page, FUNC+T select, FUNC+double-tap sample list on audio tracks, QUICK MUTE on trigs 1–16, FUNC+REC1/2 overlay create.
conditions.parameterModulation: Not applicable: no DSP, no per-sample work, no LFO or p-lock of this setting.
conditions.modeSwitching: YES toggles the checkbox; cursor motion must not. Audio-page mutes and MIDI-page mutes stay separate. T8 with MASTER ON skips the MASTER TRACK overlay on FUNC+T.
conditions.maxLoad: One instance. Worst authored event counted as every opcode in trackmutes.s once (438). Stock jsr bodies, cache and wait states are not included. Budget: 100 ms at 266 MHz (26 600 000), a key-press ceiling, not a measured limit.
conditions.inputConditions: Independent of audio. Runs in the T / FUNC+T / QUICK MUTE / UI-tick hooks. Executed authored instructions, not chip cycles. Time on the unit is not measured.

regions.name: ColdFire code and data (one linked unit, static estimate)

memory.conditions: Static instruction-length sum of trackmutes.s. m68k-elf-as was not on this Windows host, so this is not the native linker size. Detours and ANDY pokes occupy stock bytes. PERSONALIZE word 0x800000dc is stock SRAM, not extra module RAM. No DSP memory.

hardware.summary: Same-unit cards of 0.1.0–0.1.31 failed as listed in TESTING.md. 0.1.32 card: FUNC+T AED waveform follows the selected track (reported, one tester). Stress of that follow is not verified. LCD photos 25 Oct 2026 show SYSTEM STATUS TM 0.1.32 and TRACK MUTES empty then ticked; AED follow is not in those photos.
limitations: AED waveform follow after FUNC+T on 0.1.32 is reported hardware, one tester, card build; not verified and not stressed.
USB Keep/Undo, ot_emu, MIDI transport and an MKI panel are untested.
TRACK MUTES alone on a card build; Mute Modes, Play Start and Play Modes cannot share PERSONALIZE with it.
Cycle and memory figures are static authored bounds, not chip wall-clock or a linker report.
